samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_divbyodd">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by odd numbers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active low reset signal that initializes the divider.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">Divided clock output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="NUM_DIV">Odd divisor value for frequency division.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <implementation>Initializes the counter and clock divider outputs. Counts up to NUM_DIV - 1 for each edge of the input clock. Toggles the clock divider outputs when the counters reach half of NUM_DIV. Final divided clock output is obtained by ORing the two clock divider outputs.</implementation>
</module>
